title: vault-writer.md (writer-reference file) runtime body-structure contract
description: Hook-consumable runtime artifact for Vault Writers/<writer>.md writer-reference files. Per-writer definitions describing systems writing into the vault (connectors, agentic flows, auto-research, scheduled skills, custom). The writer-reference SHAPE is homed in this file-type-contracts pillar; the vault-writers pillar carries operational config.

_design_notes.consumer: hooks/pre-write-guard.sh branch #3 (vault-writers-writer-reference-only — frontmatter conformance DENY on schema violation) + librarian writers-index-refresh / writers-overlap-refresh / writers-health-audit
_design_notes.lockstep_pair: governance/vault-writers-rules.json (operational defaults + enums). The templates/vault-writers/ body templates are DROPPED: /govern register --kind writer composes frontmatter + body inline from contract-field knowledge; the foundation accepts contract-only file-types — there is no body_template to keep in lockstep.

excluded_paths_rationale: Librarian-managed derived artifacts; writers_allowed: [librarian] enforced by branch #3 / branch #4 parallel pattern.

destinations_entry_shape.path_format: Mustache-substituted path; foundation-shipped variable namespace = {{date}}, {{title}}, {{slug}}, {{source_id}}. Paths MAY be outside vault root for raw-data staging cases (e.g., a chat scrape writing structured records to ~/.claude/state/raw-data/<source>/messages.sqlite); the in-vault default applies to human-readable processed outputs like Meeting Notes (default raw landing = outside-vault structured; in-vault markdown reserved for direct-read artifacts).

raw_retention.description: Per-writer raw retention policy. Additive optional. Mandatory-default for writer_kind in {agentic-flow, auto-research}; opt-in for direct-fetch connectors. Raw retention preserves pre-distillation transcripts/sources for replayability of LLM-driven writers, and serves as the precaution substitute for the retired _landing/ folder convention.

partition_strategies.daily_jsonl: High-volume scrapers (gchat-scrape, teams-scrape pattern); one JSONL file per UTC date under $VAULT_WRITER_STATE_ROOT/raw/<writer-id>/<YYYY-MM-DD>.jsonl
partition_strategies.per_record_json: LLM-driven writers (meeting-processor, agentic-flow); one JSON file per source record under $VAULT_WRITER_STATE_ROOT/raw/<writer-id>/<source-id>.json

raw_retention.worm_immutability: Raw retention files are append-only or write-once-and-immutable; reconciler + doc-amender MUST NOT mutate raw files post-write. Daily integrity check via librarian writers-health-audit.
raw_retention.manifest_link: Each write to a destination records raw_path in manifest.sqlite writes table (writer-manifest-schema.json :: raw_path column). The reconciler populates this field from packet metadata.
raw_retention.backup_locality: Storage root $VAULT_WRITER_STATE_ROOT defaults to ~/.local/share/brain-stem/vault-writers/ (XDG-compliant; Time Machine / restic backup-included).
